async def act(page):
    # Hover over the Reports link to expand the menu
    reports_link = page.get_by_role('menubar').get_by_role('link', name=' Reports')
    await reports_link.hover()
    # Wait briefly for the menu to expand and become visible
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1500)
    # Click on the Tax link under the expanded Reports menu
    tax_link = page.get_by_role('menubar').get_by_role('menu').get_by_role('link', name='Tax')
    await tax_link.click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
